description: Follow package, publisher, repository and domain changes of a tool in your watchlist. Uses an existing paid watch pass and never purchases one. The listing must already be in your watchlist. No separate purchase. Sources refresh every six hours through shared caches. Source quotas can defer a check. History records before, after, source and observation date. Domain expiry alerts use 30, 15 and 7 days when the registry publishes a date. Missing dates and source failures remain unverified. Account holders receive operational e-mail; wallet owners read API history. No account-recovery or takeover attempt is made.
name: watch_dependency_changes
title: Watch dependency changes
